title: Control Node With Custom Min Size / Size (ex: 16x16, 8x8) is not responding to mouse enter/exit by itself, need a child TextureRect node with same size as parent Control
body:
### Tested versions

My current build v4.8.dev.custom_build [9552dfb68] only for godot tracy; tested on v4.7.2


### System information

Godot v4.8.dev (9552dfb68) - Linux Mint 21.2 (Victoria) on X11 - X11 display driver, Multi-window, 1 monitor (1920x1080 @ 60.00 Hz) - OpenGL 3 (Compatibility) - NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1060 6GB (nvidia; 580.178.04) - Intel(R) Core(TM) i7-4790 CPU @ 3.60GHz (8 threads) - 15.55 GiB memory - PulseAudio (44100 Hz, Stereo/mono)

### Issue description

Control Node that has a custom min size/size (16x16, tested on 8x8 works) with a child TextureRect of same custom min size/size is able to detect mouse enter/exit properly compared to childless Control with custom min size/size. I asked Grok AI for a smaller file size node which says ColorRect but mouse hover don't work.

I set TextureRect to modulate the alpha to 0 which works for this mouse enter/exit bug

I am expecting the Control Node with custom min size/size alone should handle mouse enter,exit 

### Steps to reproduce

Create Control Node with custom min size/size
Add TextureRect with a texture and matching parent custom min size/size

attach this script for the Control

```gdscript
extends Control

var _mouse_hover: bool = false


func _ready() -> void:
	mouse_entered.connect(sr_mouse_entered)
	mouse_exited.connect(sr_mouse_exited)


func sr_mouse_entered() -> void:
	_mouse_hover = true
	print("frame hover texturerect true")


func sr_mouse_exited() -> void:
	_mouse_hover = false
	print("frame hover texturerect false")
```

Do the same with ColorRect as child 

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

[control-with-texture-rect-and-color-rect-mouse-hover-bug.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/33437274/control-with-texture-rect-and-color-rect-mouse-hover-bug.zip)
